concept: CloudWatch Anomaly Detection: ML alerts without static thresholds
tests: Which CloudWatch feature automatically finds anomalies in metrics without manual thresholds.
expected: CloudWatch Anomaly Detection: ML learns the metric's normal pattern (band) and alerts on deviations. Triggers: "detect anomalies in metrics automatically", "without manually setting static thresholds".
why_not: Static threshold alarms need manual thresholds; CloudTrail Insights is API-activity anomalies, not metrics; Config rules are compliance.
